decisions.reason: Same story as the cyberscoop piece (mf:160083) already tracked: Trump presidential memorandum establishing a federal program for vetted private-sector companies to run government-directed cyber surveillance and effects operations against foreign cyber-enabled transnational criminal organizations, expanding EO 14390 of 2026-03-06. Adds the DOJ/DHS oversight framing.

Dell advisory with substance: CVE-2026-67261 in Dell VSI for VMware vSphere Client before 10.11.1.0 lets unauthenticated remote attackers execute arbitrary OS commands with root privileges; fixed in 10.11.1.0. No in-the-wild exploitation claim.

GBHackers write-up of the August 2026 Exchange Server security update (six vulns: RCE, privilege escalation, DoS, spoofing, security-feature bypass), disclosed 2026-08-11 with CVE-2026-62913 updated the following day. Same wave as the tracked Patch Tuesday story; Qualys roundup already lists Exchange Server in the August release.

Distinct technical report on China-linked Jewelbug abusing public Google Docs as a C2 delivery channel: obfuscated payloads embedded in documents, retrieved and executed by victim implants, traffic resolving through Google-owned infrastructure to evade reputation-based filtering. Different finding from the existing Jewelbug group-profile story.
